description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of ten channel pairs, the fifth followed by a readable SBR payload with an SBR header and no other holding any: too few for the stream to be HE-AAC, so it stays AAC LC at 22050 Hz.
findings: only 1 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data after a channel element

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.decode: ffmpeg prints "No quantized data read for sbr_dequant" for the SBR payload in the middle of the stream.
